summary: Accepted E-CI-DOM for bounded artifact reuse: all 27 physical snapshots in each React, DOM, and swap profile match the literal typed-state/View/outerHTML/live-control oracle; removal/remount, ordered cancellation, effects, detached controls, and 17 renderer swaps with 32 rejected retired-callback probes are verified against the exact primary artifact. The provider lifecycle run failed before native replay and withheld the final matrix check, so this does not establish native Go equivalence or full CI success.
